name: LS – AI Image Generator
author: lakestylez

sections.description:
LS – AI Image Generator allows you to generate high-quality AI images directly inside the WordPress editor using your own API keys.

The plugin is designed for bloggers, agencies and businesses who want full control over their AI image generation without external subscriptions or hidden costs.

You only pay the AI provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini) directly — LS – AI Image Generator itself does not proxy or resell API usage.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on third-party services for AI image generation. Depending on your configuration, prompts and context (such as post title or content) are sent to:
* OpenAI (https://openai.com)
* Google Gemini (https://ai.google.dev)

Usage of these features is governed by the respective service provider’s terms of service and privacy policy. API keys are required and must be obtained directly from the providers.

Key Features

  • One-click prompt generation based on post or page title
  • SEO-friendly image titles and alt text automatically generated
  • Full support for Gutenberg and the Classic Editor
  • Wide selection of aspect ratios (e.g., 1:1, 3:2, 2:3)
  • Support for OpenAI and Google Gemini image models
  • Automatic image attachment and featured image assignment
  • Clean, model-aware UI (unsupported options are disabled automatically)
  • Uses your own API keys — full cost transparency and no hidden fees
  • DIVI, Elementor and Colibri compatible (via Addon)

Pro Version Features

  • Access to additional image models
  • Brand-aware image generation with Corporate Identity colors
  • Advanced prompt logic (generation based on full content)
  • Standalone image generator in the Media Library
  • Priority feature updates and dedicated support

Addon & Compatibility

Compatibility for DIVI, Elementor and Colibri is available via an official addon. You can find more information and the addon download on our landing page:
LS – AI Image Generator Addon

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Open Settings → LS – AI Image Generator
  3. Enter your API key (OpenAI and/or Google Gemini)
  4. Edit a post and generate a featured image from the editor sidebar or as Standalone in the Media Library

Notes

  • Image generation costs depend on your AI provider and usage
  • Google Gemini image models currently do not reliably support visible text rendering inside images
  • Some options may be model-specific and are automatically adjusted
